setup: SELECT warren.create_graph('g', 'SELECT id FROM nodes', 'SELECT src, dst FROM edges', directed := false)
params: SELECT src AS source FROM (SELECT src FROM edges UNION ALL SELECT dst FROM edges) e(src) GROUP BY src ORDER BY count(*) DESC, src LIMIT 1

workloads.name: diff
workloads.sql: SELECT warren.diff('g', (SELECT min(version_id) FROM warren.versions), (SELECT max(version_id) FROM warren.versions))

workloads.name: bfs_depth6_cte
workloads.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r (id, depth) AS (SELECT {source}::bigint, 0 UNION SELECT n.id, r.depth + 1 FROM r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT dst FROM edges WHERE src = r.id UNION ALL SELECT src FROM edges WHERE dst = r.id) n (id) WHERE r.depth < 6) SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM r

workloads.name: components
workloads.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT component_id) FROM warren.components('g', NULL::bigint)

workloads.name: embedding_d64_load
workloads.sql: SELECT warren.vector_from_query('g', 'emb', 'SELECT id, (SELECT array_agg(sin(id * k)::real) FROM generate_series(1, 64) k) FROM nodes', 'f32')

workloads.name: gather_collect
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM warren.gather('g', 'SELECT id, id FROM nodes', NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint[])

workloads.name: gather_sum
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM warren.gather('g', 'SELECT id, id FROM nodes', NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'sum')
